DATUM.CAPTION: Želite li promjeniti datum promjene stope PDV-a ?

INSERTFORM.CAPTION: Odaberite artikal i odaberite novu stopu poreza

INPUT.NAME: robaid
INPUT.CAPTION: Roba:*
INPUT.ONLOSTFOCUS: if @@robaid is not null begin select rtrim(t.naziv) +' '+ convert( varchar(10),p.stopa1)+'%' as poreziid, j.naziv as jmnaziv from roba r with(nolock) inner join jm j with(nolock) on r.jmid=j.jmid inner join tarifa t with(nolock) on r.tarifaid=t.tarifaid inner join porezi p with(nolock) on r.tarifaid=p.tarifaid where r.robaId = @@robaid end

INPUT.NAME: NoviPoreziid
INPUT.CAPTION: Nova stopa poreza:*
INPUT.SQL: select poreziid, rtrim(t.naziv) +' '+ convert( varchar(10),p.stopa1)+'%' as Naziv from porezi p with(nolock) inner join tarifa t with(nolock) on p.tarifaid = t.tarifaid order by 2

INPUT.CAPTION: Klasa:*
INPUT.NAME: klmasterrobaid
INPUT.SQL: select KlMasterRobaId, naziv, sortkey from KlMasterRoba with(nolock) order by sortkey

INPUT.NAME: StariPoreziid
INPUT.CAPTION: Stara stopa poreza:*
INPUT.SQL: select poreziid, rtrim(t.naziv) +' '+ convert( varchar(10),p.stopa1)+'%' as Naziv from porezi p with(nolock) inner join tarifa t with(nolock) on p.tarifaid = t.tarifaid order by poreziid desc

NEODABRANO.CAPTION: Neodabrana roba za promjenu stope PDV-a

OBRISISTAVKU.ONLOAD: select robaid, naziv as roba from tempprompdv where robaid = @@stavke and operateriid = @@operateriid and susersname = suser_sname ()
OBRISISTAVKU.CAPTION: Želite li obrisati robu ?

DELETEFORM.ONLOAD: select robaid, naziv as roba from roba with(nolock) where robaid = @@id
DELETEFORM.CAPTION: Želite li obrisati robu ?

IZMJENI.ONLOAD: select convert(varchar(20),userid) +' ' +naziv as roba, p.poreziid as StariPoreziid from roba r with(nolock) inner join porezi p with(nolock) on r.tarifaid = p.tarifaid where robaid = @@id
IZMJENI.CAPTION: Izmjena stavke

INPUT.NAME: StariPoreziid
INPUT.CAPTION: Stara stopa PDV-a:*
